status: Declared after primary four-arm results, before any turn comparison calculations; secondary diagnostic only.
fixed_events: All EXACT first six I41 component-turn times, axes, incoming/outgoing signs and analytic component extrema from corrected turn_events.json; no favorable event selection.
windows: Each fixed reference event time minus1s through plus2s, both observation endpoints included.
geometric_overshoot: max(0,incoming_sign*(actual_component_position-reference_component_extremum)) over full declared window; report post-event maximum separately.
actual_reversal: First actual component sign change to the reference outgoing sign sustained>=100ms inside window. Use copied corrected I41 actual_reversal_candidates, including literal-zero plateau handling; report missing/multiple candidates.
reported: Per-arm six-turn geometric overshoot, first actual reversal lag, local/time-aligned errors and projection boundary flags. Compare each against baseline descriptively, no statistical claims.
unchanged: Primary report, its screen, simulations and defaults remain unchanged. Reference component reversals occur at nonzero vector speed and are not full robot stops.
